questions.def: 'Had' is used for the past perfect, action completed before another past action.
questions.question: By the time he arrived, the concert ___ already begun.

questions.def: 'Had studied' expresses regret about a past action (third conditional).
questions.question: I wish I ___ harder in school.

questions.def: 'Had lived' indicates a completed action before another past action.
questions.question: He ___ in Paris before moving to Rome.

questions.def: 'Was' is the correct past continuous form for a singular subject.
questions.question: I ___ writing the report when the power went out.

questions.def: 'Were supposed' indicates a past obligation or expectation.
questions.question: They ___ to finish the project yesterday.

questions.def: 'Had gone' signifies an action completed before another past action.
questions.question: By the time we arrived, they ___ home.

questions.def: 'Must have' expresses a logical deduction about a past action.
questions.question: She ___ been studying all night; she looks exhausted.

questions.def: 'Knew' after 'as if' describes a hypothetical or untrue situation.
questions.question: He acted as if he ___ everything.

questions.def: Use 'listened' in conditional clauses instead of 'would listen'.
questions.question: If he would listen, he might understand better.

questions.def: 'Had been' expresses a regret about a past state (wish + past perfect).
questions.question: I wish I ___ taller when I was younger.

questions.def: 'Scarcely had' is used for inversion, showing something happened immediately after.
questions.question: Scarcely ___ he entered the room than the phone rang.

questions.def: 'No sooner had' requires subject-verb inversion and the past perfect.
questions.question: No sooner ___ the announcement than people started cheering.

questions.def: 'Was said' is the passive form, indicating a general belief.
questions.question: It ___ that he was a brilliant scientist.

questions.def: 'Had' for past perfect continuous: activity in progress before another past event.
questions.question: She ___ been working on the project for months before it was cancelled.

questions.def: 'Had arrived' after 'would rather' refers to a past action.
questions.question: I would rather you ___ earlier.

questions.def: 'Had done' indicates completed action before another past action.
questions.question: He ___ the dishes before I arrived.

questions.def: 'Was going' indicates a past intention that was not fulfilled.
questions.question: He ___ to be a doctor, but he changed his mind.

questions.def: 'Made' is used after 'It's high time' to express urgency for a past action.
questions.question: It's high time you ___ a decision.

questions.def: 'Had known' emphasizes duration up to a point in the past.
questions.question: I ___ him since we were children.

questions.def: 'Wouldn't have' indicates a hypothetical unfulfilled action in the past.
questions.question: He ___ finished the report even if he had stayed up all night.

questions.def: 'Had had' - past perfect form after 'wish' to express regret.
questions.question: He wished he ___ more time to study.

questions.def: 'Had arrived' indicates a prior completed action in the past.
questions.question: By the time the police came, the thief ___.

questions.def: 'Hardly had' is used to show the quick sequence of two past events.
questions.question: Hardly ___ she sat down when the doorbell rang.

questions.def: 'Had witnessed' after 'as though' shows hypothetical past action.
questions.question: He spoke as though he ___ the accident himself.

questions.def: Past perfect 'had become' shows the action finished before another past action.
questions.question: By the time the ambulance arrived, he ___ unconscious.

questions.def: 'Be' follows 'imperative' in a subjunctive clause expressing necessity.
questions.question: It was imperative that the evidence ___ preserved.

questions.def: Past perfect 'had lived' describes an action completed before another past action.
questions.question: She ___ in Paris prior to her relocation to Rome.

questions.def: 'No sooner' requires inversion and past perfect/simple past.
questions.question: No sooner ___ the announcement made than the crowd dispersed.

questions.def: 'Wish' + past perfect expresses regret about the past.
questions.question: I wish I ___ harder in my youth.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous 'had been waiting' emphasizes duration before past action.
questions.question: They ___ for hours before the meeting commenced.
